objective: 在R45已正式冻结300个fresh blind画像的H0与H0+DNN预测后，首次且一次性生成同窗口Hfull标签，检验R44模型能否在整体及三个BurstGPT段稳定优于H0

execution.environment: local CPU worktree with explicit read-only external protected raw directory

blind_contract.evaluation_rule: first reproduce all 300 target-free R45 feature/H0 rows exactly; only then generate Hfull and join to immutable R45 predictions by profile_id

acceptance_gate.overall: H0+DNN/H0 ratio must be strictly below 1.0 for calls histogram WAPE, bytes histogram WAPE, mean calls TV and normalized payload EMD
acceptance_gate.segments: each of three segments must have four-metric composite ratio <1.0 and calls/bytes histogram WAPE ratios <=1.05
acceptance_gate.scientific_outcome: CONFIRMS_H0_PROTECTED_IMPROVEMENT only if both overall and all-segment gates pass; otherwise DOES_NOT_CONFIRM
acceptance_gate.paired_bootstrap: 20000 deterministic profile-level resamples of H0 minus DNN mean profile calls-L1 and bytes-L1; confidence intervals are supporting evidence and do not alter the frozen gate
acceptance_gate.request_count_strata: report the same ratios for each of ten pre-frozen request-count strata without using them for selection

stop_and_block_if: HEAD is not exact W46, any R45 file/manifest or protected raw hash differs, or the Phase45 selection cannot be reproduced exactly
any target is generated before all 300 target-free feature/H0 rows match R45 below tolerance
the evaluator would train, load a checkpoint, recompute/change predictions, tune alpha/model/metric/gate, or omit an unfavorable row
any raw row, complete request list, model weight, cache or PID would enter Git
claim_boundary: Phase46 can confirm or reject blind generalization for Qwen3-8B pure P1-D1 across three BurstGPT segments
it does not cover Mooncake, the other five models, physical RDMA time, placement, latency or online scheduling
workflow PASS means integrity passed; scientific_outcome separately records whether H0+DNN beat H0
